clusters.headline: Officials Call For Thorough Investigation Into Prabowo Wiretapping
aiSummaryBullets: Government officials and public figures are calling for a thorough police investigation into the alleged wiretapping of President Prabowo Subianto.
Bahlil Lahadalia has denied any involvement in the incident, suggesting the accusations may be intended to weaken the Golkar Party.

clusters.headline: Mount Semeru Erupts Amid Search Efforts For Two Missing Hikers
aiSummaryBullets: Mount Semeru experienced multiple volcanic eruptions characterized by ash columns and the release of hot clouds reaching 5.5 kilometers.
Search and rescue teams have been deployed to locate two hikers from Sidoarjo who were reported missing during their ascent on Mount Semeru.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Officials Respond To Allegations Of Illicit Surveillance
aiSummaryBullets: The Head of the State Intelligence Agency stated that the surveillance activities allegedly involving former National Police Chief Listyo Sigit Prabowo could indicate treason.
Multiple high-profile figures, including labor leader Said Iqbal and government official Bahlil Lahadalia, have claimed to be targets of the unauthorized monitoring.

clusters.headline: Energy Minister Bahlil Lahadalia Denies Wiretapping Allegations
aiSummaryBullets: Energy Minister Bahlil Lahadalia officially denies allegations of involvement in a wiretapping controversy.
The minister announced intentions to issue legal subpoenas against those spreading rumors linking him to the case.

clusters.headline: Central Java Integrates Health Services And Patra Logistik Expands
aiSummaryBullets: The Central Java provincial government has integrated free health checks with mobile specialist services to improve village-level access.
This initiative aims to facilitate early disease detection by allowing residents to receive specialist consultations outside of hospital settings.

clusters.headline: Badminton Athlete Jonatan Christie Donates Asian Games Bonus Funds
aiSummaryBullets: Badminton athlete Jonatan Christie received a bonus of Rp1.5 billion from the Indonesian government for his gold medal win.
The award was earned during the men's team event at the 2026 Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Police Leadership Receives Support Amid Internal Reform
aiSummaryBullets: Former Brimob commanders pledged their support for Police Chief Suyudi Ario Seto regarding his ongoing efforts to reform the police institution.
The Chief of Police stated that the force remains unified while addressing an internal investigation into illegal wiretapping involving high-ranking officers.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Public Institutions And Regional Governments Receive Awards
aiSummaryBullets: Interior Minister Tito Karnavian was recognized with an Outstanding Leadership award at the 2026 CNN Indonesia Awards.
Various regional governments received accolades for advancements in digital governance, inclusive infrastructure, and public healthcare coverage.

clusters.headline: TNI Investigates Fatal Helicopter Crash In Central Kalimantan
aiSummaryBullets: Military personnel recovered the flight data recorder from the MI-17 helicopter that crashed during a firefighting operation in Central Kalimantan.
The accident resulted in the deaths of three soldiers, with military leaders overseeing formal burial rites for the deceased.

clusters.headline: KPK Clarifies Timing Of Asset Seizure From KAI President Director
aiSummaryBullets: The Corruption Eradication Commission (KPK) stated that Rp2 billion was seized from Bobby Rasyidin in August 2025.
Officials clarified the investigation concerns alleged corruption in fuel station digitalization projects, not Rasyidin's role at PT KAI.
